facebook.content:
The Kingdom does not honor “busy‑ness,” it honors “being‑filled.” When we chase tasks we empty the throne room; when we sit in the presence, the Spirit fills us and the work flows. “Seek first the kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you” (Matt 6:33).  

What will you release today so the Kingdom can fill you and produce its harvest?
